knn_gpu: compute k nearest neighbors of query vectors against database vectors on a GPU without building an index
pairwise_distance_gpu: compute all pairwise distances between query and database vectors on a GPU without building an index
index_cpu_to_gpu_multiple_py: transfer a CPU index to multiple GPUs by building C++ resource and device vectors
index_cpu_to_all_gpus: clone a CPU index to all available GPUs automatically using default GPU resources
index_cpu_to_gpus_list: clone a CPU index to a specified list of GPUs or the first n GPUs with custom options
